items.title: Managed cross-Region disaster recovery for Amazon OpenSearch Service
items.summary: Amazon OpenSearch Service now offers managed cross-Region disaster recovery for domains on OpenSearch 3.7 or later. It replicates data from a primary domain to a secondary domain in another Region with API-driven switchover and failover, providing an RPO under 1 minute and an RTO under 20 minutes.
items.creator: Cedric Pelvet
